zh.title: 香料航空簽署20架客機租賃協議 擬提升冬季營運運能
zh.summary: 香料航空完成20架客機租約；預計將營運機隊擴至31架；每日營運約200航班。
body: 印度低成本航空公司香料航空（SpiceJet）已與三家飛機營運商達成協議，將在2026年10月中旬至11月中旬期間，引進20架租賃客機，以在冬季旅遊旺季前重建營運運能。
本次引進的20架客機包含15架波音與5架空中巴士（Airbus）飛機，並採用濕租及濕乾混租方式交機。其中空中巴士機隊將包含高載客量的空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）。
香料航空目前僅營運11架飛機。在新增20架租賃客機後，其營運機隊預計將擴增至約31架，並能在冬季班表期間維持每日約200個航班的營運規模。

en.title: SpiceJet Agrees to Lease 20 Aircraft to Expand Fleet Ahead of Winter Schedule
en.summary: SpiceJet has agreed to lease 20 Boeing and Airbus aircraft to support winter operations.
body: Indian low-cost carrier SpiceJet has finalized agreements with three aircraft operators to lease 20 aircraft between mid-October and mid-November 2026, as it seeks to rebuild capacity ahead of the winter travel season.

The lease package comprises 15 Boeing and five Airbus aircraft under a combination of wet-lease and damp-lease arrangements. The incoming Airbus fleet will include higher-capacity Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321) models to support high-demand routes.

SpiceJet currently operates 11 aircraft. The addition of the 20 leased jets is expected to increase the airline's active operational fleet to approximately 31 aircraft, allowing it to operate about 200 daily flights during the winter schedule.

zh.title: 印度航空A320neo巡航時三套液壓系統失效 24傷
zh.summary: 印度航空A320neo三液壓系統失效 24傷 機長藥檢呈陽性
body: 印度航空一架空中巴士A320neo（註冊號VT-EXO）於2026年8月4日執飛AI2379航班，從普吉國際機場（HKT）前往英迪拉·甘地國際機場（DEL），在36,000呎巡航時，三套液壓系統在4秒內相繼失壓。印度航空器事故調查局（AAIB）初步報告指出，綠色液壓系統於UTC 04:02:43失壓，4秒後藍色與黃色系統也失壓，導致自動駕駛於04:02:48斷開，失速警告於04:02:51鳴響2秒。
飛機隨後爬升372呎超過指定高度，隨後下降292呎低於指定高度，總垂直偏離達664呎。液壓壓力在數秒內恢復，藍色系統於04:02:52左右恢復，黃色與綠色系統隨後恢復。AAIB指出三套系統相互獨立，無液體轉移。
事發時繫安全帶指示關閉，導致20名乘客與4名機組人員受傷，其中4人傷勢嚴重住院。機組決定繼續飛往德里，於UTC 05:30降落。機艙受損包括天花板面板破裂、行李艙門脫落、緊急出口把手斷裂及廁所馬桶脫離固定。
飛行員與空管均未報告惡劣天氣。根據印度民航局（DGCA）要求，因航班起飛地在印度境外，兩名飛行員抵達後接受檢測。酒精測試合格，但機長精神活性物質篩查呈非陰性，確認性血液檢測亦同；副駕駛兩項測試均陰性。報告未披露檢出物質。
AAIB發布暫時安全建議，要求DGCA打擊精神活性物質濫用，稱此發現屬嚴重關切，但未將機長檢測結果與液壓失效建立關聯。該機於7月28日依最低裝備清單（MEL）延派動力傳輸單元（PTU），AAIB記錄該延派但未認定與失壓有關。空中巴士專家透過法國民航安全調查分析局（BEA）於8月13至15日檢查飛機，液壓部件與油樣已送測。

en.title: Air India A320neo loses all three hydraulic systems at 36,000 ft; 24 injured
en.summary: Air India A320neo loses three hydraulic systems; 24 injured; captain tests positive for psychoactive substance
body: An Air India Airbus A320neo (registration VT-EXO) operating flight AI2379 from Phuket International Airport (HKT) to Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) lost pressure in all three hydraulic systems within four seconds while cruising at 36,000 feet on August 4, 2026. India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) preliminary report states the green system pressure loss was detected at 04:02:43 UTC, followed by the blue and yellow systems four seconds later. The autopilot disengaged at 04:02:48 UTC and a stall warning sounded for two seconds at 04:02:51 UTC.

The aircraft climbed 372 feet above its assigned altitude and then descended 292 feet below, a total vertical excursion of 664 feet. Hydraulic pressure returned within seconds, with the blue system recovering at approximately 04:02:52 UTC, followed by the yellow and green systems. The AAIB noted the three systems are independent, with separate reservoirs and no fluid transfer.

The seat belt signs were off at the time. Twenty passengers and four cabin crew received medical attention after landing in Delhi at 05:30 UTC, with four people hospitalized for serious injuries. Cabin damage included cracked ceiling panels, dislodged overhead bin doors, a broken emergency exit handle, and a lavatory commode torn from its mounting.

Neither the flight crew nor air traffic control reported adverse weather. Under DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements for flights originating outside India, both pilots underwent post-flight medical checks. Breath analyzer results were satisfactory, but the captain's psychoactive substance screening returned a non-negative result, confirmed by a laboratory blood test; the co-pilot tested negative in both screenings. The report does not identify the substance.

The AAIB issued an interim safety recommendation urging the DGCA to act against psychoactive substance abuse, calling the finding a serious concern, but drew no link between the captain's test result and the hydraulic failure. The aircraft had been dispatched from Phuket on July 28 under a Minimum Equipment List item covering the power transfer unit, an auxiliary pressure source for the green and yellow systems; the AAIB recorded the deferral but made no connection to the pressure losses. Airbus specialists, working through France's BEA, examined the aircraft from August 13 to 15, and hydraulic components and fluid samples have been removed for testing.

zh.title: 全日空確認追加訂購八架E190-E2訂單
zh.summary: 全日空確認追加八架E190-E2；價值6.42億美元；2028年起交付
body: 巴西航空工業於2026年9月3日發布聲明，確認全日空控股已在2025年合約基礎上再下單八架E190-E2，並在聲明中指出「On September 3, 2026, Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190-E2s on top of the contract from 2025.」。
根據在東京證券交易所披露的SEC文件，這八架飛機價值6.42億美元（約1,050億日圓），文件載明「A SEC Filing , disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, placed the price of the eight aircraft at $642 million (Y105 billion).」。

全日空控股表示，首批飛機預計在2028財年開始交付，追加的八架E190-E2則安排在2029至2032年間陸續到貨，原文稱「Deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, while the eight additional E190-E2s are scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, according to ANA Holdings.」。

全日空控股社長兼執行長柴田浩二指出：「This additional E190-E2 order accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan… It also underscores our confidence in Embraer’s technology to reduce both environmental impact and operating costs.」，強調訂單將加速日本地區航空網絡建設並降低環境影響與營運成本。

巴西航空工業商用飛機部門社長兼執行長Arjan Meijer回應：「We are honored by ANA HD’s continued confidence in Embraer E2 small narrowbody aircraft and look forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan.」，表達對合作深化的榮譽與期待。
背景方面，全日空於2025年2月宣布首度引進E-Jet機隊，訂購20架E190-E2（含15架確定訂單與5架選擇權），選擇權仍保留；2026年7月29日董事會決議再購區域噴射機，隨後於9月完成本次八架確定訂單。

en.title: All Nippon Airways finalises additional order for eight Embraer E190-E2 jets
en.summary: All Nippon Airways confirms eight more E190-E2 jets worth $642M; deliveries from 2028
body: On 3 September 2026 Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190‑E2 aircraft on top of the 2025 contract, noting “On September 3, 2026, Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190-E2s on top of the contract from 2025.”.

A SEC filing disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange values the eight aircraft at $642 million (¥105 billion), stating “A SEC Filing , disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, placed the price of the eight aircraft at $642 million (Y105 billion).”.

ANA Holdings said deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, with the eight additional E190‑E2s scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, quoting “Deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, while the eight additional E190-E2s are scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, according to ANA Holdings.”.

ANA Holdings President and CEO Koji Shibata said the order “accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan… It also underscores our confidence in Embraer’s technology to reduce both environmental impact and operating costs.”.

Embraer Commercial Aviation President and CEO Arjan Meijer responded that the company is “honored by ANA HD’s continued confidence in Embraer E2 small narrowbody aircraft and look forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan.”.

Background: In February 2025 ANA announced its first E‑Jet order for 20 E190‑E2s (15 firm, 5 options), with the options still outstanding. On 29 July 2026 the board approved the acquisition of more regional jets, leading to the finalised eight‑aircraft order announced in September.
